extName.description: Extension name in the store and browser

extDescription.message: Modify request and response headers per profile. Import your ModHeader profiles. Runs locally, sends nothing anywhere.

openInTabTitle.message: The same editor in a browser tab, with more room

needsAccess.message: Headerwise needs access to sites to change their headers.

noAccessHere.message: Headerwise has no access to this site, so nothing is changed here.

cantChangeThisPage.message: Browsers don't let extensions change headers on this page.

noMatchedRulesApi.message: This browser doesn't tell extensions which rules matched, so this is based on the page address.

matchedRulesError.message: Chrome can't say right now which rules matched here ({error}).

line_excluded.message: skipped here: never on {pattern} matches this page

line_notIncluded.message: only on {patterns}: this page doesn't match (its requests to other sites still can)

line_waiting.message: nothing changed here since your last edit: reload the tab

line_narrowed.message: only {scope}: none here since your last edit

profileTabTitle.message: {title}. Drag (or Alt+←/→) to reorder: the leftmost profile wins when two set the same header

timerSelectTitle.message: Switch this profile on, and off again after a while

onlyThisTabButtonTitle.message: Apply this profile only in the current tab, until it closes

duplicateTitle.message: Copy this profile (the copy starts switched off)

headerAction.message: What to do with the header

secretOnTitle.message: Secret: value hidden. Click to show it always

secretOffTitle.message: Mark as secret: hide the value

startHere.message: Start here: type a header name and value above, paste a request copied in DevTools, or pick a preset.

secretsEverywhere_one.message: {names} goes to every site your pages talk to, third-party scripts and fonts included.

secretsEverywhere_other.message: {names} go to every site your pages talk to, third-party scripts and fonts included.

addOnlyOnFilter.message: Add an "only on" filter below to keep them to your own sites.

presetTitle.message: Add a ready-made set of headers

variablesHint.message: Variables: {list}. Chrome sends fixed values, so Headerwise fills them in on every edit and once a minute: requests within that minute share one value.

pastePlaceholder.message: In DevTools → Network, right-click a request → Copy as cURL, fetch or PowerShell, and paste it here. Plain "Name: value" lines work too.

pasteNoHeaders.message: No headers found in that text.

pasteOnlyHost.message: make this profile apply only on {host}

redirectFrom.message: Replace this part of the address

redirectFromPlaceholder.message: part of the URL, e.g. api.example.com

redirectsHint.message: Replaces the first match in the address of a request and sends it there. A new redirect switches on once both fields are filled; to cut text out, leave the second empty and tick it yourself. "Only on" filters don't apply to redirects; "never on" and the other limits do.

scopeHint.message: Nothing ticked means all. "From sites" is the page that made the request: a page opened from the address bar or a bookmark has none, so it doesn't count.

preset_iframe.message: Allow the site in an iframe

moveFromModHeader.message: Move from ModHeader (turned off in Chrome)

importPlaceholder.message: …or paste an export from Headerwise, ModHeader, Requestly or Simple Modify Headers

includeSecrets.message: Include secret values (tokens, cookies). Only for your own machines.

rateIt.message: Rate it in the Chrome Web Store

footerLocal.message: Runs locally. No account, no analytics, nothing is sent anywhere.

diagnosticsCopied.message: Copied. Warnings are included as they are: check them before posting.

m_pasteWin.message: In the folder picker, paste it into the address bar at the top and press Enter.

m_pasteMac.message: In the folder picker, press ⌘ Shift G, paste it and press Enter.

m_pasteLinux.message: In the folder picker, press Ctrl+L, paste it and press Enter.

m_someUnreadable.message: Some files in the folder could not be read, so these may not be your latest profiles: {errors}

m_cantReadFiles.message: Could not read ModHeader's files: {errors}. Copy the folder somewhere else and pick the copy, or close the browser that uses it and try again.

m_noProfiles.message: No ModHeader profiles in that folder. Check the path below, or try the same path with "Sync Extension Settings" instead of "Local Extension Settings".

m_stepAccess.message: Let Headerwise change headers on sites. Chrome applies the changes itself; Headerwise never reads your pages.

m_stepPin.message: Pin the icon: click the puzzle piece in the toolbar, then the pin next to Headerwise. Click the icon to add headers.

m_intro.message: Chrome and Edge turned ModHeader off in July 2026, so its Export button is gone. Your profiles are still in its folder on your disk. Headerwise reads them right here, in this page. Nothing is uploaded or sent anywhere.

m_addedHint.message: Click the Headerwise icon in the toolbar to see them. Once you are happy, you can remove ModHeader from the extensions page.

m_step1.message: 1. Copy the path to ModHeader's folder

m_firefoxHint.message: This reads ModHeader's folder from Chrome or Edge on this computer. If you used ModHeader in Firefox and it still opens, use its Export button and "Import JSON" in the Headerwise popup instead.

m_profilesHint.message: If you use several browser profiles, ModHeader may be in another one: open {version} in the profile where you used it and replace {path} with its "Profile Path".

m_uploadHint.message: The browser will ask whether to "upload" the files to this page: that only lets Headerwise read them here.

m_orDrag.message: or drag the folder onto this page

m_tokensHint.message: Profiles often hold tokens and cookies. They stay in this browser only.
